scope: Local uncommitted release review. No commit, push, tag, package upload, or new 50B experiment.
host: Linux x86_64; Intel Xeon Gold 5218R; GCC 13.3; RTX 4090; CUDA 13.0.88

checks.name: fully_scalar_cpu
checks.configuration: Native, AVX2 and AVX512 options OFF

checks.name: native_address_and_undefined_sanitizers
checks.note: Native ISA macros activate the new real AVX-512 kernels, independent of the separately dispatched complex-kernel build option.

checks.name: cuda_fp64_cpu_and_actual_device
checks.note: Fresh CMake CUDA FP64/arch89 build; CPU, existing CUDA, JIT, packed JIT and symbolic JIT. Existing JIT caches may be reused; not cold-JIT timing evidence.

checks.name: portable_wheel_from_new_sdist
checks.configuration: SYMFT_PY_NATIVE=0; wheel built offline from sdist, installed into isolated target; import path checked
checks.note: importlib.metadata version and symft.__version__ both 2026.10.8; symft.__release__ is symft_26_10_08. Local Linux wheel, not published.

checks.name: three_way_cpu_benchmark
checks.note: Seven repeats per variant and distance; warmups and same-stream replays are not independent rare-event evidence. Raw local archive: review-artifacts/cpu-261008-final.

checks.name: archived_50B_source_and_journals
checks.note: Original source/journal hashes, stream identities, raw totals and timings still match. Archives were not modified.

checks.name: documentation_and_git_hygiene
checks.command: python3 tools/check_documentation.py; git diff --check; git diff --cached --check
checks.note: Local links/fences, release identity, API names, benchmark arithmetic and build-artifact exclusions. External links and rendered GitHub layout are not checked.
